name: Bitch na Ano Ko ni Seikatsu Shidou! JK Bitch ★ Hame Pako School Life
original_name: ビッチなあの娘に性活指導！　ＪＫビッチ★はめぱこスクールライフ
source:
The protagonist, Onoda Seiichi, is assigned as a temporary teacher at the private Hakogawa Academy. However it was a problematic school, commonly known as “Pako School” due to its violent disturbance of morals. Seiichi is given a condition by the principal to be officially employed as a teacher:

——Rehabilitate all the 'problem children' who disrupt the school's discipline

The students considered problem children are all beautiful girls with quirky and slutty personalities!
Will Seiichi be able to rehabilitate those troublemakers amidst the erotic happenings that come one after another?

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/mytre_0002/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
主人公小野田精一被任命为私立箱川学园的临时教师。然而，这是一所问题学校，因严重扰乱道德而被俗称为“帕科学校”。校长给精一正式聘任教师的条件是：

——对所有扰乱学校纪律的“问题儿童”进行平反

那些被认为是问题儿童的学生，都是性格古灵精怪、放荡的漂亮女孩！
在接二连三的情色事件中，精一能否让那些麻烦制造者平反呢？

[译自[url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/mytre_0002/]DMM[/url]]
